inferred_contracts.meaning: Recognized update sites call read/add/write during tokenization, before later reduction; old-value capture and rollback remain unknown
The optional ret field selects a context target after string/expression resolution, rather than proving a returned-value slot
Context depth changes trigger trimming of deeper variable tables; complete object destruction and alias rules remain unknown
Reviewed shared call path handles 16 slots from field 3, retaining holes and recording the highest present slot plus one
subr has additional auxiliary-state save/restore; its full ownership and external effects are unresolved

exploratory_findings.reason: Initial selector 0x69b2e8 explains list expansion, not update timing; actual update helper is 0x69fd90
Selector 0x6c17c8 allocates an auxiliary record; it is not the unresolved virtual frame creation method
